findings.finding: మూల \eta-సంకోచన నియమానికి x పదం Mలో స్వేచ్ఛగా లేకపోవాలి; తరువాతి తుల్యతా నియమం \lambd[x][f x] \equal f పక్కన అదే షరతు కనిపించదు. సిద్ధాంత నిరూపణ ఏ Mకైనా ఆ షరతుతోనే నియమాన్ని వాడుతుంది.
findings.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding contraction definition explicitly says x notin FV(M). The later proof invokes the eta step for arbitrary M subject to x notin FV(M), which requires the equivalence rule to have that generalized conditional sense. If f were a fixed distinct variable, the displayed rule alone would be too narrow for the proof; if f ranged over arbitrary terms without freshness, the rule would be too broad.
findings.required_translation_handling: Keep the frozen formula, but explicitly state beside it that f denotes a term with x notin FV(f); disclose that the source did not repeat the condition. Do not claim this note adds a new proof.
